scope: Post-save read-only property refresh; ARM Kylin V10 native GUI and GaussDB 507 centralized A database

fix: ObjectPropertiesEditor refreshes only read-only form values for stateful objects after successful save processing. No explicit compilation, command reset or nested source-editor refresh. Editability is checked again when asynchronous values are applied.
